tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Find providers in the AgentBroker Index by name, type, what an AI agent can do there (place orders, draft orders, read only, none), supported assistant (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, any MCP client…), asset the agent can trade, and Spain availability/licence. Returns sourced, dated summaries. Read-only; in

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Full AgentBroker Index entry for one provider: integrations (hosted/local MCP, ChatGPT app, Claude connector, API, CLI, skill), supported assistants, what the agent can do, documented limits and approvals, availability by market, legal entity and licence status in Spain, assets, source URLs and chec

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of AI-agent access for 2-4 providers: capability, integrations, assistants, limits, Spain availability and licence, sources. Order follows your input; this is not a ranking.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: Dated changelog of launches and changes (new MCP servers, connectors, permission changes), each with its source URL. Filter by date or provider.

tools.name: dataset_info
tools.description: Counts, last full check date, licence (CC BY 4.0), attribution text, download links, methodology page, and the latest monthly report on AI-agent access in Spain (https://agentbrokerindex.com/es/informe/2026-11/) with its headline findings.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
